proposedWording: Riêng câu này của bản chép Toàn Thư, khi Tử Vi cùng Tả Phù và Hữu Bật đồng cung Tài Bạch, sách dùng hình ảnh “財賦之官” — chức việc liên quan tài chính, kho tàng. Đây là cách mô tả truyền thống của cấu hình đang xét; không xác nhận nghề nghiệp, tài sản hoặc kết quả cuộc đời.

grammarRationale: 紫微輔弼同宮 is an explicit direct-cohost configuration. 或作三方為次吉 introduces an alternative with a lesser grade. The following comma and 在財帛宮則為財賦之官 admit a broad attachment to the whole preceding pattern and a narrower attachment to the immediately preceding 三方 alternative. The direct-host reading is plausible, and later 財宅 / 紫微輔弼多為財賦之官 corroborates the fiscal image. Neither the later parallel nor modern punctuation uniquely establishes that the fiscal clause licenses direct-host sufficiency in this exact sentence. Under the packet requirement to reject remaining attachment ambiguity, I cannot approve the exact same_palace AST as a source-certified sufficient subset. This is unresolved scope, not proof that the direct reading is false. I do not replace the frozen AST or rewrite the frozen wording.
pairedAuxiliaryRationale: 輔弼 is the paired 輔 / 弼 expression; the full Juan3 section explicitly labels 左輔右弼 and alternates 左右 with these names. Requiring both normalized Tả Phù and Hữu Bật is a defensible bounded direct configuration; there is no warrant here for OR, any benefic, or replacing either auxiliary.
modifierRationale: The brightness line lists 紫微 branch states but is not a syntactic universal threshold for this individual verse. Other nearby verses explicitly state 無刑忌, 無殺湊, 居旺地, 更兼權祿 or particular birth stems; these are not stated on the target verse and must not be imported mechanically. 紫微破軍無左右無吉曜 is not an adverse prohibition on a triple containing both 左右. 紫破命臨於辰戍丑未再加吉曜 is expressly a 命 clause. 紫微武曲破軍會羊陀 has an additional 武曲 and cannot silently become a universal exclusion. The positives all include Phá Quân and one includes Kình Dương; no whole-chart favorable judgment follows. General Juan3 synthesis does require considering auspicious/adverse mixtures and brightness for actual fortune judgments, which this imagery-only wording expressly avoids.
wordingRationale: The Vietnamese wording accurately bounds 財賦之官 as traditional fiscal/treasury-office imagery and disclaims actual profession, property, or life outcomes. However it asserts the fiscal image for the exact direct-host condition. Its disclaimers do not cure the unresolved locative attachment. Therefore I withhold approval of this exact wording, while finding its translation and empirical limitations otherwise appropriate.
